main_idea: GRPO training improved Qwen3.8-27B’s DeepSWE pass rate from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO improved DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points.
Training used eight attempts per task across 15 updates.
Tasks came from private codebases and covered five languages.
summary: The chart is clear, but the stats row, explanatory cards, header details, and footer branding add secondary information.
